assumptions.candidate_eligibility: The listed municipal library, education, youth, and indoor-sports facilities are reviewed hypothetical hosts for a temporary generic neighbourhood-support service. Their inclusion does not establish availability, suitability, staffing, legal authority, opening hours, or present service capacity.
assumptions.population_privacy: Only cells published by HSY are included; suppressed residents are not imputed.
assumptions.snap_connectors: Each source point is joined to its nearest network node by a straight projected Euclidean connector. The connector is an analytical approximation, not an observed walking link or verified entrance.
